title: Read a guarded one-dimensional GAN example
description: You inspect the generator and discriminator update paths and the recorded availability branch.

steps.description: You first check TF_AVAILABLE. The other branch prepares Gaussian real data and training settings for a generative adversarial network, or GAN.
You define a generator from noise to one value and a discriminator from one value to a real-data probability. Separate optimizers accompany binary cross-entropy loss.
You label real samples one and generated samples zero for the discriminator loss. The gradient update targets discriminator.trainable_variables.

steps.question: Which variables does the generator training step update?
steps.answer: It applies gradients to generator.trainable_variables. Its target labels are ones, encouraging generated samples to receive high real-data scores.

steps.description: You read the available-library path's alternating updates, loss plots, and real-versus-generated histograms. Those operations all remain inside the else branch.
You see the unavailable-TensorFlow message in the recorded output. This recording takes the first branch and produces no trained-network results.
